derived_synthetic: Plants A and B are perturbed academic approximations inspired by public ranges for Monte Claro and 14 de Julho.
Power limits, reservoir bands and level anchors were rounded or displaced and are not operational records.
Quartic forebay and tailwater curves were constructed for smooth synthetic behavior and are not fitted proprietary coefficients.
synthetic_assumptions: Seven hourly inflow scenarios and their random perturbations
One-hour travel time from A to B
Constant efficiency and gravitational acceleration of 9.81 m/s2
Aggregated turbine per plant, spill response and penalty weights
excluded_material: dispatch rules, constraints or calibrated parameters from SOG2
